schema:
CREATE TABLE child(
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    code TEXT,
    slot INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY(code, slot) REFERENCES parent(code, slot)
)

CREATE TABLE mix(
    tag TEXT NOT NULL,
    ident BLOB NOT NULL,
    note TEXT,
    payload BLOB,
    gravity REAL,
    PRIMARY KEY(tag, ident)
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE ord(
    n INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    label TEXT NOT NULL
) WITHOUT ROWID

CREATE TABLE parent(
    code TEXT NOT NULL,
    slot INTEGER NOT NULL,
    label TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(code, slot)
) WITHOUT ROWID
